name: Delaney Quinn
bio: Delaney Quinn is an actress who played the role of Freddy in the 2026 horror film Buddy. In 2025, she appeared in the drama film If I Had Legs I'd Kick You. Her TV career has included shows like The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel and New Amsterdam.

credits.title: Buddy
credits.overview: Inside the colorful world of "It's Buddy!", a group of children spend their days singing, dancing, and helping Buddy - bright orange unicorn - spread happiness. But when one child refuses to play along, Buddy is not pleased and cracks begin to appear in this seemingly perfect world.

credits.title: Pittsburgh
credits.overview: It’s 1979, and the plane on which nine year old Mints is traveling – unaccompanied – gets rerouted to Pittsburgh, where she must spend one chaotic night with a boozy stewardess who abandons her to party with the pilot. Mints sets out to find a reliable adult in a world that seems to lack them.

credits.title: If I Had Legs I'd Kick You
credits.overview: With her life crashing down around her, Linda attempts to navigate her child's mysterious illness, her absent husband, a missing person, and an increasingly hostile relationship with her therapist.

credits.title: Eugene the Marine
credits.overview: A former marine fights to keep his life from unraveling as his son tries to force him out of his longtime family home and a series of gruesome murders begin targeting the people around him.

credits.title: The Roses
credits.overview: Life seems easy for picture-perfect couple Ivy and Theo: successful careers, a loving marriage, great kids. But beneath the façade of their supposed ideal life, a storm is brewing – as Theo's career nosedives while Ivy's own ambitions take off, a tinderbox of fierce competition and hidden resentment ignites.

credits.title: The Reunion
credits.overview: An old-money family gathers at their estate to celebrate the matriarch’s birthday—but their real intention is to send her off to a nursing home and begin scheming over her inheritance.

credits.title: By The Window
credits.overview: A fringe high school student decides to investigate a local kidnapping after becoming obsessed with a surveillance video of the abduction.

credits.title: The Beanie Bubble
credits.overview: Ty was a frustrated toy salesman until his collaboration with three women turned his stuffed animals into a defining '90s trend. This behind-the-scenes look at history's biggest toy craze is a wild story about what—and who—is valued in this world.

credits.title: The F-Word
credits.overview: When a young girl asks her father what the word "fuck" means, he falls into a feedback loop of explaining its many definitions.
